meta.question: on Waterbirds K=29, along training (epoch 25, 50, final), is the masked teacher fed MaskedKD's student-picked tokens less correct and less covered by the teacher's own evidence on the minority groups than the one fed v1's tokens, and does that gap grow with training?
meta.method: attention rollout (teacher all blocks, student blocks 6..11); last-block CLS attention; keep-only masked-teacher faithfulness (accuracy, top-1 agreement, KL) sliced by Waterbirds group; within-group image bootstrap
meta.paper: Abnar & Zuidema ACL 2020 (rollout); Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD); Hooker et al. NeurIPS 2019 (keep-only); Sagawa et al. ICLR 2020 (Waterbirds groups)
